name: structure
description: Keep a repo easy for agents to read: cap authored files at 5000 tokens, cap folders at 7 entries, warn Claude Code at edit time, and set up import boundaries between modules.

interface.shortDescription: File size, folder fan-out and import boundaries for agents
interface.longDescription: Sets up structure checks in any repo. setting-up-the-checks copies two scripts to scripts/: check-file-size fails when an authored file passes 5000 tokens (bytes/4), check-fan-out fails when a folder holds more than 7 entries, with a baseline for today's overages and an excludes file. It wires both into lefthook pre-commit, pre-push and GitHub Actions, or plain git hooks, plus a Claude Code PostToolUse hook that runs them on each edited file. setting-up-import-boundaries writes per-repo import-linter contracts for Python and dependency-cruiser rules for TypeScript and wires them into lint and CI. Failures say how to split or group along deep modules.
defaultPrompt: Use $setting-up-the-checks to cap file size and folder fan-out in this repo
Use $setting-up-import-boundaries to enforce module layers here
